testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-signed-in.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23080 locked sales rep cannot sign in and unlocked sales rep can

scenario.summary: The admin locks a sales rep from the listing; the sales rep cannot sign in to admin or webstore. The admin unlocks it on its Manage page and saves; the sales rep signs in to both.
steps: On the Sales Rep listing find the sales rep (@rep.userName); click Lock; click Ok.
Sign in as the sales rep (@rep.userName, @rep.password) on the admin URL and on the webstore of its store.
Re-open the sales rep's Manage page; click Unlock (enable); Save and Close.
Sign in as the sales rep on admin and webstore.
stateChanges: The sales rep is locked, then unlocked (deleted at teardown).
assertions: Locked: admin and webstore sign-in are refused
Unlocked: admin and webstore sign-in succeed
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 8 (group A remainder) and answers in sections 6 and 8.3.
FSD 'Manage an Existing Sales Rep': disabled or locked cannot sign in; enabled and unlocked can.
atstage 10.14.7.0: Lock is a row action of the listing; the Manage page offers Enable (unlock) (analysis section 8).
The sales rep signs in on the suite's admin URL and on its own store's webstore (storeA.webstoreDomain), as 23079.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
